info.title: API.SH: Equibase
info.description: The Equibase API from API.SH: public Equibase data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The days a track has results (default) or entries on Equibase, newest first.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/equibase-calendar

parameters.name: track
parameters.description: Equibase track code (e.g. CD Churchill Downs, SA Santa Anita, GP Gulfstream Park, BEL Belmont Park, WO Woodbine), or an equibase.com track, entries or results link.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Track country code as Equibase writes it (USA, CAN, PR...; default USA).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: results (default) or entries.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A track's entries for one day: every race with number, post time, race name and stakes id, race type, purse, conditions, wagers offered, distance, surface, starters, and each runner with program number, post position, horse and id, where bred, sire, dam and dam's sire, age, sex, medication, claiming price, jockey and id, weight, trainer and id, morning-line odds and a scratched flag. Without `date` it answers the track's next card (today, else tomorrow, else the next listed day); without `track` the first featured track racing today.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/equibase-entries

parameters.name: track
parameters.description: Equibase track code (e.g. CD Churchill Downs, SA Santa Anita, GP Gulfstream Park, BEL Belmont Park, WO Woodbine), or an equibase.com track, entries or results link.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Track country code as Equibase writes it (USA, CAN, PR...; default USA).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Race day, YYYY-MM-DD (cards are published a few days ahead and kept for recent days).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The tracks with published entries: code, country, name, whether Equibase features it, and the card dates it lists for today, tomorrow, later days and recent past days.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/equibase-entries-tracks

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A horse's profile: name, where bred, breed, colour, sex, foaling date, sire, dam and dam's sire with their ids, jockey, trainer and owner at the last start, breeder, latest sale, career record (starts, wins, seconds, thirds, earnings), record by year with best speed figure and earnings per start, race results (track, date, race, race type, finish, speed figure), upcoming entries, recent workouts and auction history (sale, hip, type, buyer, consignor, price, status).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/equibase-horse

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Equibase horse reference number (refno) or an equibase.com horse profile link. Find it with /equibase/v1/search.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A jockey's profile: name, best racing class achieved, this year's and career record (starts, wins, seconds, thirds, earnings), record by year (earnings per start, win and in-the-money percentages), upcoming mounts (track, date, race, race type, purse, surface, horse, trainer) and recent results (finish per mount).

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/equibase-jockey

parameters.name: breed

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Scratches and late changes posted for a track's current race day: race, program number, horse and id, the change (scratch and reason, jockey change, equipment, weight...) and the time posted. `scratches_only=true` keeps the scratches.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/equibase-late-changes

parameters.name: scratches_only

get.description:
Leader boards for horses, jockeys or trainers: by year (default, current year), all time, or a track's meet. Each row: rank, name and id, starts, wins, seconds, thirds, top-three finishes, earnings, earnings per start, win and top-three percentages (horses also sire and best speed figure). 100 per page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/equibase-leaders

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: horses, jockeys (default) or trainers.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: year (default), all_time or meet (needs `track`).

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Year for period=year (default this year).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: earnings (default) or wins.

parameters.name: track
parameters.description: Equibase track code (e.g. CD Churchill Downs, SA Santa Anita, GP Gulfstream Park, BEL Belmont Park, WO Woodbine), or an equibase.com track, entries or results link.

parameters.name: meet_start
parameters.description: period=meet: the meet's first day, YYYY-MM-DD (default the latest meet; the answer lists the track's meets).

parameters.name: breed
parameters.description: TB (default), QH or AR.

parameters.name: page

get.description:
A track's results for one day: every race with race name, stakes id and grade, race type, off time, age restriction, purse, distance, surface, track condition, winning time, the top three with jockey and win/place/show prices, the also-rans, the full order of finish, every exotic payoff (wager, winning numbers, payoff), the winner's breeder, owner, trainer, jockey and sire, and the chart PDF link. Without `date` it answers the track's latest results day; without `track` the latest results of the first listed track.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/equibase-results

get.description:
Horses (name, year of birth, sex, sire, dam), jockeys, trainers, tracks or graded stakes races whose name matches, with their Equibase ids. When exactly one record matches, that record is returned with its id.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/equibase-search

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Name to look for (a horse name; a jockey's or trainer's last name; a track or stakes name).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: horses (default), jockeys, trainers, tracks or stakes.

parameters.name: first_name
parameters.description: Jockeys and trainers: first name, to narrow the search.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A graded stakes race: name, track, city, race facts (fastest time, largest margin, highest speed figure), the latest winning horse, trainer, jockey and owner, the next running's date and race number, the race's history by year (date, name, grade, course, track, distance, purse) and past winners (horse, trainer, jockey, speed figure).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/equibase-stakes

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Equibase stakes id (stkid) or a stakes profile link. Find it with /equibase/v1/search?type=stakes.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
